subject.title: Add per-agent sandbox session visibility override feature

question: Should OpenClaw land this narrow per-agent sandbox session-tools clamp independently, or fold it into the broader per-agent session visibility and A2A policy work before merge?
rationale: The code path is coherent and proof-backed, but the change intentionally broadens what a named sandboxed agent may see and conflicts with adjacent per-agent session policy work, so automation should not choose the security/product boundary.

options.title: Consolidate then rebase
options.body: Pick one canonical per-agent session policy shape, fold or rebase this sandbox clamp into it, and require fresh proof after conflict resolution.

options.title: Land the narrow clamp
options.body: Accept the explicit per-agent sandbox override as a separate feature, then ask the contributor to rebase this PR and keep the broader A2A work separate.

options.title: Pause this surface
options.body: Keep the default-only sandbox clamp for now and close or park this PR until the broader per-agent session policy is ready.

recommendation.title: Consolidate then rebase
recommendation.body: Pick one canonical per-agent session policy shape, fold or rebase this sandbox clamp into it, and require fresh proof after conflict resolution.

likelyOwner.reason: The history and CODEOWNERS context point to this handle for session-tool helper architecture and security-sensitive sandbox policy decisions.
